title: Preserve actual observation meaning through recording
statement: The Review and verification Module shall prepare attributable occurrence and observation content that preserves actual execution state, assessed scope and contrary evidence through explicit retention without inventing results.

what.problem: Assurance preparation and retention can conflate planned methods, actual observations, semantic judgment and current reliance.
what.desired_outcome: Preserve actual observation meaning through recording.

why.rationale: SR-026 needs accountable assurance content and failure semantics in MOD-007.

conditions: An assessor prepares or reassesses assurance content for a declared engineering claim.

contexts: MOD-007 contribution to MOD-017 IF-014; guided recording through MOD-012 and existing IF-004/003.

how.approach: Apply assurance-content.md to exact supplied bases, preserve gaps and actual actor decisions, then confirm selected retention separately.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-026 criteria within the declared finite claim; operational persistence and execution authority retain their existing owners.

acceptance_criteria: Identify the occurrence, method and criterion basis, exact observed subject/state, actual conditions, observing source and supporting evidence.

Distinguish unperformed, unable-to-assess, interrupted and completed activity from favorable, adverse or inconclusive criterion observations; preserve actual partial observations and the unassessed remainder.
Expose missing provenance, exact state or unavailable supporting bytes as limitations, and never substitute expected observations for actual results.

Preserve relevant conflicting/adverse observations and their original provenance when current summaries are replaced until an accountable disposition resolves their reliance; later favorable results cannot erase them.
Confirm retention through actual selected artifact or command outcomes, preserve unresolved effects after interruption, and never replay a stale prepared update automatically.
constraints: Target Design; no implemented automation, executed verification or requirement satisfaction is asserted.

sources.basis: Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
